name.description: Library name, without its package scope. A comma-separated list (core,ui,browser) adds several libraries with the same options in one change.

scope.description: Architectural scope tag and project prefix. Also supplies the npm scope unless packageScope is provided; defaults to the workspace name.

packageScope.description: Independent npm package scope, with or without @. Does not change the architectural scope.

publishable.description: Generate a buildable package in packages/ instead of an internal library in libs/. Does not enroll it in release automation.

access.description: Registry access for a publishable package; defaults to restricted.

skipInstall.description: Write dependency declarations but do not run the deferred dependency installation.

testRunner.description: Generate a Node-hosted Vitest test target and separate spec config (requires Node 20.19+, 22.12+, or 24+), or explicitly opt out with none.

yes.description: Apply the reviewed plan; otherwise only display it.

allowDirty.description: Permit unrelated uncommitted work. Generation still fails, writing nothing, when a file it would write (or a lockfile an install would rewrite) has uncommitted changes.
